apis.versionNotes: UIDT/setNotification/onNetworkChanged/canRunUserInitiatedJobs API34; setRequiredNetwork/getNetwork API28; getStopReason API31; older scheduler/service callbacks API21. API34+ network scheduling requires ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE. Notification permission API33, package notification query API24, channel APIs26, immutable PendingIntent API23. BIND_JOB_SERVICE protects an exported=false service. canRunUserInitiatedJobs does not establish visibility eligibility. NetworkRequest.Builder.addTransportType/removeCapability API21; canBeSatisfiedBy API30 is a diagnostic capability comparison, not scheduler-readiness or endpoint proof. apis.runtimeGuard: Probe min35 covers UIDT APIs. Request actual LAN permission under API41 on runtime37/target37. Notification denial is displayed and requested separately; it does not block scheduling in this probe. Always supply required job notification; keep native-screen Cancel available and qualify actual notification-action visibility. Null or changed assigned network interrupts without default-route fallback. Task Manager can kill the process without onStopJob; durable claimed-attempt checks prevent automatic replay. Reviewed 0.4.1 permits a matching existing VPN by removing NOT_VPN only; retain WIFI/ETHERNET alternatives and other defaults. Never change VPN settings or select its underlying network. VPN transport labels may include Wi-Fi and cellular together and do not prove a physical Wi-Fi-only route. One selected fixture was reached through the OS-assigned network; other endpoints, physical routes and general VPN/provider behavior remain unqualified.

partialObservation.note: 0.4.1 on the identified HP API37 build: two actual 64 MiB HTTPS completions with independent exported-file SHA-256 validation, including a fresh explicit retry after host-stop failure. Active Activity recreation/minimize/return retained the attempt. Native UI and hidden-Activity notification cancellation reached saved terminal states with stable partial bytes. Wrong-CA-only input failed with SSLHandshakeException before payload; host-stop midstream failed with ProtocolException and no automatic retry when the fixture returned. An injected package-scoped SIGKILL during claimed work left historical running state; a new process reconciled the same attempt to interrupted with unchanged 5,177,344-byte partial/hash and no observed replay over more than 64 seconds. Eight retained slots also blocked further Start, so post-recovery Start eligibility is not established. That original run made no wrong-hostname, permission-revocation, assigned-network-change, Task Manager, natural low-memory, physical-input, general VPN or product gate claim.
partialObservation.followupNote: Accepted separate 0.4.1 batch: trusted CA with wrong hostname rejected with SSLPeerUnverifiedException before payload; active native task closure/return retained one exact 64 MiB download. Restart cause and actual Task Manager UI behavior remain unqualified. Direct-LAN denied-socket enforcement, revocation and assigned-network changes remain untested.
